newsitem.title: UK: London gold down at fixing but finds support.
newsitem.headline: London gold down at fixing but finds support.

text.p: GOLD - Fixed at $315.75 vs $320.80 previously. Heavy speculator selling and new shorts opened. Some producer selling too. Some support. May test low at $313.60. Under pressure.
SILVER - Found support at $4.25 after falling on speculator selling. $4.26/$4.28 down nine cents.
PLATINUM - Also weakening. $396.00/$400.00 ahead of Russian deliveries due July 10. PALLADIUM - $170.00/$174.00 down $4.00.
